data.name: Jyoti
data.gender_notes: Jyoti is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit jyotiṣ, 'light', from the root jyut, 'to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit jyut (ज्युत्). A classical Sanskrit term for light. Jyoti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Light; flame; radiance”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jyoti expresses “Light; flame; radiance”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit jyotiṣ, 'light', from the root jyut, 'to shine'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jyoti total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

vedic_reference.note: Jyoti is a popular name in Hinduism and has its roots in the Vedic scriptures. It is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. In the Rigveda, Jyoti is mentioned as a symbol of enlightenment and knowledge.
